853:t_18:8.en:
$$カツ$$
「F-fate? You mean... I die like that?」

853:t_18:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ha ha ha, catch me if you can~! But watch out for what's ahead of you~!」

853:t_19:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Miss $$ハマーン$$!」

853:t_19:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please, don't be so wary. Just be honest and enjoy it, Miss $$ハマーン$$.」

853:t_19:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're right... Having come this far, there's no need to be so stiff.」

853:t_19:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Exactly. Why not freshen up your mood, put your hair in twin tails like in the old days, and try acting spoiled with Mr. $$シャア$$?」

853:t_19:8.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...It seems I must first discipline a rude robot...」

853:t_19:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-w-w-wait... Please go easy on me, nothing too hard...」

853:t_20:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Oh, AG... Sorry to make you go out of your way.」

853:t_20:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all... Just being allowed to stay close to you, Mr. $$アムロ$$, is enough for me.」

853:t_20:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm not one of those cute girls you like, you know.」

853:t_20:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all... My dream is to compile your exploits, Mr. $$アムロ$$, into a single book and publish it.」

853:t_20:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's reading material, after all. I'll add some embellishment, just a little. Only a little, mind you.」

853:t_20:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For example, I'll write your remark just now as: 'Mecha fetishist $$アムロ・レイ$$ harbored a desire to become a pretty girl.'」

853:t_20:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So this is how my outrageous anecdote book gets put together...」

853:t_21:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「Oh, AG... I made you go out of your way.」

853:t_21:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「Perhaps it's because I no longer carry any superfluous titles, and so I can focus on what's in front of me.」

853:t_21:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see... So you've cast aside your doubts ahead of the final battle.」

853:t_21:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's truly '$$シャア$$'s Final Chapter'! Let's say this catchy phrase together!」

853:t_21:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even you can't shake it off that much, I see... Of course not...」

853:t_22:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$ハサウェイ$$!」

853:t_22:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, has your relationship with Miss $$クェス$$ progressed at all?」

853:t_22:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... Miss $$クェス$$ is under Mr. $$ブライト$$'s supervision, after all. You can't easily make a move.」

853:t_22:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you like, I, AG, can prepare some props for getting closer to her, both legal and illegal.」

853:t_22:9.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「No thanks, I'll pass on that kind of thing.」

853:t_22:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What are you saying!? Are you one of those trendy herbivore types!?」

853:t_22:11.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「It's not that. ...It's just that $$クェス$$ and the world both have a lot going on right now, so I have to think about that kind of thing properly.」

853:t_22:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Surprisingly mature... Next to this, I'm the one who looks like a middle schooler who just learned the ropes...」

853:t_23:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「Thanks, AG. It really is nice to have somebody celebrate for you like this.」

853:t_23:5.en:
$$クェス$$
「I know! I'll go tell the Colonel, $$アムロ$$, $$ハサウェイ$$ and the others too!」

853:t_23:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... Miss $$クェス$$... I still had all sorts of congratulatory rituals to perform...」

853:t_23:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... never mind. With so many people around to celebrate her, Miss $$クェス$$ must be very happy right now.」

853:t_24:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$ギュネイ$$!」

853:t_24:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「This is nothing. I'm going to be a man who surpasses both the Colonel and $$アムロ$$.」

853:t_24:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that case, you must train even harder.」

853:t_24:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You don't need to tell me. I'll shoot down even more enemies, become the unshakable ace of $c, and...」

853:t_24:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But if you keep fighting like that, what do you intend to do once the war is over?」

853:t_24:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you say you'll surpass those two as a man, you'll also need to grow as a human being. Do keep up your training, Mr. $$ギュネイ$$.」

853:t_24:10.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're right, but coming from you it somehow makes me angry!」

853:t_24:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To become an ace as a person too, we'll have to start by fixing things like that...」

853:t_25:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm not asking for a reaction, so please stay just as you are.」

853:t_25:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, allow me to read out a congratulatory telegram from Miss $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$.」

853:t_25:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The prank is a great success! I got a reaction out of Mr. $$ヒイロ$$.」

853:t_25:11.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Don't worry. It's what you call a prank.」

853:t_25:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-wait...! I'm already a full-blown surprise-and-startle mecha as it is!」

853:t_25:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A-at least say 'I'll kill you' first, then do it!」

853:t_26:4.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Somehow when you're the one congratulating me, shady comes to mind before happy...」

853:t_26:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How rude! In that case, I'll cut the celebration short!」

853:t_26:6.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I'm kidding! Don't take it seriously, AG!」

853:t_26:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I know. Mr. $$デュオ$$ is known for loving a good joke, after all.」

853:t_26:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mr. $$デュオ$$'s Grim Reaper sayings... Those are every bit as devastating as my Dimension Joke collection.」

853:t_26:9.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Why, you! Is this payback for earlier!?」

853:t_26:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... let's get along, shall we? We're the Grim Reaper and the Devil tag team, after all.」

853:t_26:11.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Geez... You're someone I can never tell how much is serious and how much is a joke...」

853:t_27:4.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Words of celebration, huh... They hardly suit me.」

853:t_27:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's not true. Everyone is born blessed.」

853:t_27:6.en:
$$トロワ$$
「But I don't have a name, the first thing that should have been given to me.」

853:t_27:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course you do. You have the fine name $$トロワ・バートン$$.」
